# The Beyond Human Method

> The Beyond Human Method is the energy clearing and alignment practice of Tamara Rose, based in the Rocky Mountains of Colorado and working with clients online. It is for people who have done the work (therapy, coaching, mindset, meditation) and still find the same pattern repeating in their money, relationships, work or health. Tamara finds the one primary pattern underneath, clears it at the energy level and helps clients align with a reality they choose, so the change holds.

Key ideas, in Tamara's words:

- If you've done the work and you're still stuck, the gap isn't in what you know; it's in your alignment. What you're aligned in is what shows up, so changing your reality means changing your alignment, not adding more effort.
- Most people carry one primary pattern (for example "I'm not good enough," "I'm not inherently valuable," or "I have to overproduce to create value"). It usually started in childhood or was inherited through the family line, and it runs underneath every area of life.
- The method has three parts: identify the root pattern, co-create a new reality the person actually wants, and align their energy field (thoughts, feelings and actions) with it. Living in the new reality is where the real change happens.
- Energy clearing is not therapy, coaching or meditation, though it works well alongside them. It works on the pattern at the energy level rather than on understanding it.

## Start here

- [Energetic Alignment Audit](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/audit): a private 90-minute session on Zoom with Tamara that names your primary pattern, where it came from and what becomes possible when it clears. Includes the recording, transcript and a written Energetic Blueprint. A $1,500 value; the investment is $497, credited in full toward working with Tamara.
- [The method](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/method): how The Beyond Human Method works, step by step.
- [About Tamara Rose](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/tamara): her story, from top sales rep at a Fortune 500 company who felt trapped to founding The Beyond Human Method.

## Programs

- [Divine Self Mastery](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/divine-self-mastery): Tamara's 12-month group program to clear the primary pattern at the root, create a life you actually want and practice living it, with live sessions every month. The next cohort begins January 7, 2027.
- Private work: one-to-one work with Tamara for founders and executives. The Audit is the first step, and Tamara recommends group or private from there.
- [Free community](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/community): a free community on Circle with a 20-day meditation series and the Reclaim Your Divine Energy guide.
- [Feminine archetype quiz](https://learn.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/success-quiz): a free quiz to find your feminine archetype.
